cds.title: Angelo State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (Excel)

ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator (profile, fall 2024 admissions and test scores, 2024-25 expenses)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (Fall 2025 entering class): 6,865 applied, 5,479 admitted (79.8%), 1,359 enrolled; residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) sum to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 57 applied, 55 admitted (96%), 35 enrolled. No early decision or early action, no waitlist, rolling admission. GPA columns are the 'all enrolled students' set; 0.17% had a GPA below 1.0 and is omitted. Undergraduate enrollment 10,103 and nonresident count 295 are the B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' figures. The CDS lists SAT composite 25th/50th percentiles (860/990) but the 75th percentile cells are blank (#REF!), so the SAT/ACT percentile ranges shown come from IPEDS (fall 2024) instead.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: SAT or ACT 'recommended'; ACT-only and SAT-only 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'. C8F: Angelo State has a test-optional policy; applicants can ask to be reviewed without scores.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, full-time; the CDS ticks '2026-27 costs not available', so these are the 2025-26 figures): in-state tuition $5,620, nonresident tuition $17,770, required fees $3,964, on-campus food and housing $13,800 (housing $8,800 + meal plan $5,000). G5 estimates: books $1,200, transportation $2,050, other $1,950 (other_usd = transportation + other). Per-credit-hour: $188 in-state, $593 nonresident. H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 13 nonresidents received it (average $8,347).
